question: What happens to my pension if I die before or after I retire?

gold_sections.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 29-202

nuggets.text: On a member's death in service, the Board pays the designated beneficiary (or the estate).
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 29-202
nuggets.quote: when the Board of Trustees receives proof of death of an individual who died while employed as a member, the Board of Trustees shall pay to the designated beneficiary or, if there is no designated beneficiary, to the member’s estate the amounts specified in this subsection.

nuggets.text: The member's accumulated contributions are paid.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 29-202
nuggets.quote: Subject to paragraph (1) of this subsection, the Board of Trustees shall pay the member’s accumulated contributions.

nuggets.text: With several designated beneficiaries the payment is shared equally.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 29-202
nuggets.quote: If a member designates more than one beneficiary, on the death of the member, the Board of Trustees shall pay the amounts specified in this subsection in equal shares to each of the designated beneficiaries.
